hero.title: Where the information comes from
hero.accent: honest about what we don't know
hero.lead: Team Water puts two separate things on one screen: a base map from a map provider, and our own list of water filtration plants imported from a spreadsheet. This page explains both, and what they can't tell you.
demo: Demonstration data is switched on for this site. Plants whose ID starts with DEMO are made up for testing and are counted in the figures below. They are always labelled "DEMO — not a real plant".
layers.title: Two separate layers
layers.intro: The map underneath and the plants on top come from different places, are updated by different people, and can be wrong in different ways.
layers.map.title: Streets, shops and landmarks
layers.map.text: Drawn by the map provider, not by us. Not every street, shop or landmark is present, names may differ from local usage, and the provider updates it on its own schedule.
layers.map.fix: Report a problem with the base map
layers.plants.title: Water filtration plants
layers.plants.text: Our own records, imported from a spreadsheet and corrected only by site staff, with every change logged. Plants are drawn on top of the base map; they are never taken from the map provider.
sheet.title: The source spreadsheet
sheet.intro: The plant list comes from one Excel file with a single sheet of 1,000 rows and 8 columns: Plant ID, Town/Tehsil, Area/Union Council, Operating Entity Type, Water Source, Filtration Technology, Capacity (Gallons Per Hour) and Operational Status. We keep every original value exactly as recorded and show it under "About this record" on each plant.
stats.area: placed only at an approximate area centre
stats.none: with no usable position (text list only)
sheet.missing: Plant names, street addresses, landmarks, map coordinates, opening hours, how much water one person may collect, the operator's actual name (only a type is given), contact details, accessibility, water-test results or dates, source documents, and verification dates. Where a value is missing we say "Not provided" — we never fill it in.
caveats.title: Caveats, in plain language
caveats.location: No plant has an exact location in the file. Nearest-plant results can only point to the centre of the plant's listed area until staff pin a plant or a future file supplies coordinates.
caveats.status: Every row says "Fully Functional", with no date. We show this as "listed as operational in the source spreadsheet — undated, not verified". It is not a promise the plant is working today.
caveats.sector: Every area is written as "Area - Sector N". The sector number is applied the same way to city areas and rural chaks, and isn't a known official subdivision. No union-council numbers are given.
caveats.generic: Some area names aren't places you can find on a map: "Saline Zone A–D", "Kachi Abadi" (a general term for an informal settlement) and "Factory Area".
caveats.typo: "Chalk 224 RB" is probably a typing error for "Chak 224 RB". We keep the original and let you search either spelling.
caveats.town: The Town/Tehsil column mixes city towns (Lyallpur, Jinnah, Iqbal, Madina) with tehsils (Jaranwala, Samundri, Tandlianwala, Chak Jhumra). Faisalabad Sadar/City tehsil doesn't appear.
caveats.operator: The operator column mixes kinds of values. "Saline Water Treatment RO" describes a plant type, not who runs it. "PSPA" is an unexplained acronym, so we don't expand it.
caveats.capacity: Capacity is a production rate in gallons per hour, not a per-person or per-day allowance. The file doesn't say US or imperial gallons, so we don't convert to litres. 25,000 GPH is unusually large for a community water point and is flagged for checking.
caveats.even: The values are spread very evenly, which suggests the file may have been modelled or generated rather than surveyed. We recommend checking it with the issuing authority.
areas.title: Where area positions come from
areas.text1: To rank plants by distance we need a rough position for each area. Our area list (gazetteer) has 49 entries, but only 17 have a usable position: 11 areas, 5 towns and the airport. The rest are flagged for staff to review and position by hand.
areas.text2: Every area position is approximate. We draw it as a circle, never as a pin, and never present it as a plant's exact site. Plants whose area has no position can't be ranked by distance — search for their area or town by name to see them in a text list.
dist.title: How distances are worked out
dist.straight.title: Approximate straight-line distance
dist.straight.text: For plants with an exact site: the distance "as the crow flies" from the place you chose. Real journeys are longer.
dist.area.title: Approximate distance to area centre
dist.area.text: For plants listed only by area: the distance to the rough centre of that area. The plant itself could be anywhere in the area.
dist.route.title: Travel distance by road
dist.route.text: Only when a routing service is switched on and answering, and only for plants with an exact site. If it isn't available we say so and fall back to straight-line distance — we never guess a route.
dist.order: "Nearest" orders plants by these distances (ties are broken by plant ID, so the order is always the same). "Recommended" also weighs verified status, dated test evidence, confirmed problems and ratings, and explains its reasons on each card. Your search location is used to answer the request and is not stored.
quality.title: Water quality evidence is not a rating
quality.tests.title: Water quality evidence
quality.tests.text: Comes only from recorded laboratory tests, with the sample date and the standard used. It is historical: a past test doesn't guarantee the water today. With no test on record we say "Unknown" — never "safe".
quality.rating.title: Community experience rating
quality.rating.text: Stars from people who used the plant — about queues, cleanliness of the site, and service. It is not a water-safety measure. Below 3 ratings we show "Too few ratings", and scores are adjusted so a handful of votes can't dominate.
reports.title: Community reports are unverified until reviewed
reports.text1: Anyone can report a problem with a plant. A report is not a finding: it never changes a plant's official status by itself. Plant cards show how many unverified reports are under review, separately from issues staff have confirmed.
reports.text2: A plant's status only changes after a staff member records a documented assessment. If you think a record is wrong, report it from the plant's card, or ask for a correction.
privacy.title: What we keep, and for how long
privacy.lead: You can find plants without an account and without giving us anything. We only collect information when you choose to report a problem or rate a plant.
privacy.search.title: Searching for plants
privacy.search.text1: The place you search for, or your device location if you choose "Use my location", is sent to our server only to find nearby plants. It is not stored and not written to our logs. Your browser asks your permission before sharing your location, and you can always search by name or pick a spot on the map instead.
privacy.search.text2: The map itself is loaded from the map provider shown at the bottom of every page, which receives the usual technical information any website receives when it serves map images.
privacy.collect.title: When you report a problem or rate a plant
privacy.collect.report: What you tell us: the plant, the kind of problem, your description, when you saw it, and an optional star rating.
privacy.collect.phone: Your phone number, so staff can follow up and to limit abuse. It is stored encrypted, is visible only to authorised staff (every time it is viewed is logged), and is never shown publicly or to other users.
privacy.collect.proximity: If you choose to share that you are near the plant, we keep only the distance between you and the plant — not your position.
privacy.photos.title: Photos
privacy.photos.text: Hidden information inside photos — including GPS location and camera details — is removed when you upload them. Photos are not public: staff review them, and a photo is shown on the site only if staff approve it for publication. Please avoid photographing people's faces.
privacy.retention.title: How long we keep things
privacy.retention.search.text: Search locations and "Use my location" results.
privacy.retention.reports.text: Report text and photos are kept for 2 years, then redacted.
privacy.retention.phone.text: Phone numbers are erased 180 days after your last activity.
privacy.rights.title: Ask for a correction or deletion
privacy.rights.text: You can ask us to correct a plant record, appeal a decision about your report, or delete your phone number and the reports linked to it. Use your report reference and the last four digits of your phone number.
map.coverageDefault: Streets, shops and landmarks come from the map provider and may be incomplete.
map.updatedDefault: The map provider updates the base map on its own schedule.
